_comment: Tickers tracked every day, in addition to the automatic lists. Each one gets
a full card on the page: price history, fall from its 52-week high, its most
relevant recent headline, and whether Stocktwits, Reddit or Hacker News are
talking about it. Stocks and ETFs both work.
Edit with `python -m finance.cli watch add NET VOO` / `watch remove NET`, or
from GitHub: Actions -> Edit watchlist -> Run workflow. Hand-editing is fine
too; `name` and `kind` are filled in automatically if left out.
